title: Hamburger, Real-Encyclopädie für Bibel und Talmud – digital edition (Abtheilung I and II, Supplementbände I–VI)
description: Transcription of Jacob Hamburger's Real-Encyclopädie für Bibel und Talmud / des Judentums, the first Jewish encyclopedia in German: Abtheilung I (biblical articles, 2nd ed. 1884, 1,900 entries), Abtheilung II (talmudic articles, 1883, 853 entries) and the supplement volumes I–VI (1886–1901, 273 articles), with 43,927 footnotes in place. Structured JSON with headwords (including Hebrew forms), HTML and plain text; abbreviations explained, references to Bible, Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud and Midrash resolved, cross-references linked; also as DSL dictionaries. Transcribed with Claude (Anthropic, 2026) from page images in eScriptorium (scans of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek and the Internet Archive); a working transcription, not a critical edition. Prepared for the Safran library (https://github.com/mitkin89/Safran).
